Hair salon on West 4th, in black and gold since 2010.

The sign out front says it: Gretchen’s, in flowing gold script over a scissors shield, established 2010. Inside it is bright cream walls, stained glass, and a team in matching black and gold. Hair first, with nail and lash work done right here at the salon too.

Services

At the salon

From the salon’s Google listing, plus the nail and lash work done at this address. Tap for the details.

Haircuts and styling are the core of the salon’s listing. The team’s own posts show everything from everyday cuts to full transformations, including donation cuts and perms.

Coloring is on the salon’s listing. Tell the salon what you are picturing when you book, and they will plan the appointment.

Facials appear on the salon’s listing as well. Ask about them when you call or message.

Nail and lash work is done right here at the salon: the sets in the book above (galaxy nails, winter nails, a lash lift and tint) were all posted from this address. Book through the salon’s number or page.
